categories.name: File diff/review/undo
ci_evidence: ci.yml job 'file-changes-tests' (PASS on 9c37143); smoke scheduled in validate-local.ps1 -WithSmokes
remaining_gaps: Revert route currently returns HTTP 500 (FileChangeError) for hash mismatch when force=False; documented contract says HTTP 409.
No approval gate between staging a change and applying it (OpenCode requires explicit user confirm).
No batch revert (revert an entire turn's worth of changes atomically).
No git/VCS fallback if the local file has been edited outside the tool (no three-way merge).
No end-to-end round-trip smoke that verifies the file on disk actually matches the staged state after a session restart.
categories.next_action: File Diff Batch 2: (a) downgrade 500 -> 409 in revert, (b) add approval gate, (c) add batch revert, (d) add git/VCS fallback, (e) add end-to-end round-trip smoke. Estimated +6 weighted points (88 -> 94).
